sql_templates.description: Identify reports with potentially missing stock data in the last 20 sessions.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT er.run_id, er.run_ts, er.notes, COUNT(ehs.symbol) AS filtered_stocks
FROM report.enhanced_runs er
LEFT JOIN report.enhanced_filtered_stocks ehs ON er.run_id = ehs.run_id
WHERE er.run_ts >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
GROUP BY er.run_id, er.run_ts, er.notes
HAVING COUNT(ehs.symbol) < 5
ORDER BY er.run_ts DESC;

sql_templates.name: VCP Breakouts with Strong Fundamentals
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots 
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
),
latest_vcp AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks 
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks) 
    ORDER BY vcp_score DESC, rank ASC
),
latest_eod AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM market.equity_eod 
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
)
SELECT ev.symbol, ev.company_name, ev.sector, ev.price, ev.enhanced_fund_score, ev.trading_signal 
FROM latest_vcp ev 
JOIN latest_snapshot ss ON ev.symbol = ss.symbol 
JOIN latest_eod eod ON ev.symbol = eod.symbol 
WHERE ss.stage = 'STAGE_2' AND ev.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY') 
LIMIT 50;

synthesis_guidance: ['Focus on VCP patterns with high fundamental scores.', 'Ensure output aligns with a deep institutional review.', 'Present results as a QA checklist ready for further analysis.']
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 1752
